ocr.title: Text from image
ocr.win_lang_guide_title: Microsoft guide: how to add a language in Windows
ocr.win_lang_need: Text recognition in Windows needs the Russian language. Open “Settings → Time & language → Language & region”, click “Add a language” and choose “Russian”: text recognition is installed with it. Another option: install the free Tesseract program (second link), ClipSD will find it by itself.
ocr.win_lang_need_lang: To recognize text in {lang}, Windows needs that language installed. Open “Settings → Time & language → Language & region”, select “Add a language”, and choose it: text recognition support is installed with the language. Alternatively, install the free Tesseract program (the second link); ClipSD will find it automatically.
